D: A wooden puppet brought to life has to prove himself brave, truthful and unselfish to become a real boy.
P: Serve the mains when Pinocchio finds Geppetto inside the whale.
S: Geppetto's workshop full of clocks and toys
Little toasts of salami, provolone and a slice of pickled capsicum, laid out on a wooden board.
Mini doughnuts rolled in cinnamon sugar, and popcorn tossed with caramel, served in paper bags.
Cheddar cracker dough cut into fish shapes, baked at 180C for 12 minutes until crisp.
M: Geppetto fishing inside Monstro the whale
Whole snapper roasted with lemon, garlic and parsley at 200C for 25 minutes, with roast potatoes.
Beef meatballs with parmesan and parsley browned, then simmered 40 minutes in a slow tomato and basil sauce, served over spaghetti with extra parmesan.
W: the Blue Fairy granting the wish
Sweet pastry filled with vanilla custard and topped with blueberries, glazed and dusted with icing sugar.
K: Fresh lemonade with mint and a little honey, served cold in small glasses.

s.note: Geppetto's workshop full of clocks and toys
s.how: Slice a baguette thinly, brush with olive oil and toast at 200C for 6 minutes until crisp. Top each toast with a fold of salami, a small slice of provolone and a strip of pickled capsicum. Lay them out in rows on a wooden board like tools on a bench.

Rub 100g butter into 150g flour, then mix in 150g grated cheddar and a pinch of smoked paprika. Add a splash of cold water to bring it together and chill for 30 minutes. Roll thin, cut into fish shapes and bake at 180C for 12 minutes until crisp.

m.how: Mix 600g beef mince with grated parmesan, chopped parsley, salt and an egg, roll into balls and brown well. Add 2 cans crushed tomatoes, crushed garlic and torn basil and simmer for 40 minutes. Serve over 500g spaghetti with extra parmesan grated on top.

w.note: the Blue Fairy granting the wish
w.how: Blind bake a sweet shortcrust case until golden and cool completely. Fill with 500ml thick vanilla custard and pile 250g blueberries on top. Warm 2 tbsp apricot jam with a splash of water and brush over the berries to glaze. Dust with icing sugar and chill.

d.how: Squeeze 6 lemons into a jug. Stir 4 tbsp honey into a little hot water until dissolved, then add to the jug with 1.5L cold water. Bruise a handful of mint and drop it in with plenty of ice. Pour into small glasses and serve cold.
